summary: Crypto sentiment is mixed: Michaël van de Poppe sees a potential Bitcoin buying zone, but only if support around $74,000–$73,200 holds; a break above $75,000 could improve momentum.[3][9] Macro conditions are defensive, with a stronger dollar and hawkish Federal Reserve repricing weighing on gold, while USD/JPY approaches the intervention-sensitive 160 level.[2] Available results do not provide verified same-day commentary for most requested analysts or sufficient evidence for 15+ individual assets, so unverified signals are omitted.
